params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of an enzyme. Restricts results to those with the specified name.

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Name substring of an enzyme. Restricts results to those with names that include the provided substring.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: names.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names.

items.docs: List enzymes that can be specified for other Benchling operations.
